title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Meadow Match
moral: Cheering for your friends gives them the courage to shine.

pages.content: {{NAME}} found a beautiful meadow one sunny day. The meadow had soft pink grass and tiny glowing flowers. Fairies were setting up two small goalposts. A princess in a gold dress was blowing a silver whistle. "Welcome!" called the princess. "Today we play fairy soccer!" {{NAME}} had never heard of fairy soccer. He could not wait to find out what it was.

pages.content: The fairies explained the rules. The ball was a big glowing bubble. You could not pop it. You had to blow it gently into the goal. The princess showed {{NAME}} how to blow. He tried and blew the bubble the wrong way. The fairies giggled kindly. {{NAME}}'s cheeks went pink. But then the princess smiled. "Try again," she said gently. "You can do it."

pages.content: The game began! {{NAME}} ran after the glowing bubble. He got to it first. He leaned down and blew with all his might. The bubble soared through the air. It floated right between the goalposts. GOAL! The fairies burst into tiny happy sparks. The princess jumped up and down. {{NAME}} cheered so loud it echoed.

pages.content: One small fairy was too shy to play. She sat by the flowers alone. {{NAME}} and the princess walked over to her. They cheered her name. "Come on! You can do it!" the fairy smiled and joined in. She scored the best goal of the day. Cheering for your friends gives them the courage to shine.
